Threat Scenarios: CICD-IMPLICIT-TOKEN-PERMISSIONS: Workflow or reusable-workflow caller inherits a repository default that grants more GITHUB_TOKEN access than reviewers can see in the job.; CICD-OVERPRIVILEGED-JOB: Malicious or compromised job code uses unnecessary write or OIDC permissions to modify source, packages, deployments, attestations, or cloud resources.
Threat Actor or Source: unsupported YAML construct stale policy malformed input or verifier execution failure
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: one or more jobs cannot be evaluated but the repository is reported as least privilege
Why This Check Is Required: a distinct error state prevents incomplete permission coverage from becoming clean evidence
Required State: missing policy unreviewed workflow unsupported YAML and parse failure return an error
Expected Result: evaluation failures use exit 2 and cannot be interpreted as pass
Framework Mappings: UNMAPPED — framework review required
Limitations: The sidecar job purpose and exact permission set require semantic human review and can encode a bad decision if approved carelessly.; Static ref-condition matching does not prove branch protection tag protection or GitHub Environment approval rules are enabled.; GITHUB_TOKEN restrictions do not reduce permissions of separately supplied PATs GitHub App tokens cloud credentials or other secrets.; Actions and shell steps in one job share that job token so different trust boundaries should use separate jobs.; Fork safety and pull_request_target behavior are delegated to PSB-CICD-005 and cloud OIDC trust conditions to PSB-CICD-006.; Unknown GitHub permission scopes or unsupported YAML constructs fail closed until the verifier is reviewed and updated.
